deep_dive_report.report_title: Deep Dive OON Analysis - MCM004 Medicare GRS - R3 Period (Feb 2026 - Apr 2026)

detail_statements: Out of 45,989 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 67.0% and PMPM ratio increased by 36.7% for R3 period.
In GA, out of 45,989 total claims (for R3), 30,311 (65.9%) were NPAR, resulting in $25,777,771.14 in OON payments.

In GA, out of 215 total NPAR claims for DIALYSIS CENTER OF MILLEDGEVILLE LLC under the PPO Local product, 40.1% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In GA, no IDR-flagged claims were recorded during the R3 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
Out of 35,915 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 9.6% and PMPM ratio decreased by 59.3% for R3 period.
In CA, out of 35,915 total claims (for R3), 29,511 (82.2%) were NPAR, resulting in $16,072,532.94 in OON payments.

In CA, out of 287 total NPAR claims for HUA GU under the PPO Local product, 7.4% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In CA, no IDR-flagged claims were recorded during the R3 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.
Out of 14,873 total claims, NPAR Claims count percentage increased by 13.5% and PMPM ratio decreased by 18.7% for R3 period.
In OH, out of 14,873 total claims (for R3), 10,812 (72.7%) were NPAR, resulting in $4,253,158.08 in OON payments.

In OH, out of 114 total NPAR claims for ESSENTIA HEALTH - DULUTH (MILLER-DWAN BUILDING) under the PPO Local product, 56.6% were processed as PAR over the past 12 months. This pattern indicates potential network configuration improvement opportunities (e.g., provider/network assignment or adjudication setup).
In OH, no IDR-flagged claims were recorded during the R3 period, indicating no active dispute activity relative to overall OON volume.

STANFORD HOSPITAL shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for the same provider and facility service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.

DRG 871 (Septicemia or Severe Sepsis without Mechanical Ventilation >96 Hours with MCC) and DRG 091 (Other Disorders of Nervous System with MCC) account for approximately 80% of mapped OON reimbursements for STANFORD HOSPITAL. Note: The majority of claims (4,704 of 4,736) are classified under NOT_MAPPED DRG.

HOMETOWN HEALTHCARE shows a recurring PAR/OON reimbursement overlap for similar member populations and professional service types, indicating inconsistent network assignment and potential provider configuration gaps.
All NPAR claims (463) for HOMETOWN HEALTHCARE are classified under NOT_MAPPED DRG, preventing further DRG-level drill-down.
No IDR-flagged claims were recorded for any provider during the R3 period for Medicare GRS (MCM004). No dispute activity trend is observable.

detail_statements: During the same R3 period, NPAR claim volume increased by 965 claims (from 1,429 to 2,394) and associated paid amounts increased by $2,321,210.36 (from $4,067,941.50 to $6,389,151.86) for TANNER MEDICAL CENTER CARROLLTON, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.

During the same R3 period, NPAR claim volume increased by 25 claims (from 0 to 25) and associated paid amounts increased by $77,989.01 (from $0.00 to $77,989.01) for TEMPUS LABS, indicating higher NPAR utilization and an elevated PMPM impact (NPAR spend per member month) relative to the baseline.
